title: Appeal

replies.author: Mango_
replies.body:
Sorry, but if you don't know why you were banned or why you should be unbanned then we can't appeal your infraction. You were banned for using illegal client modifications (hacks), in particular "Auto-Sprint".

Your ban will remain valid until you can explain why you should be appealed with more detail.
